description: This file implements a plugin for the WPEFramework that provides Content Decryption Module (CDM) functionality, including managing DRM systems, sessions, and secure stops. It defines classes for interfacing with DRM systems, handling sessions, and exposing RPC interfaces for external control.

classes.name: OCDMImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the content decryption interface, managing DRM systems, sessions, and configuration.

classes.name: ExternalAccess
classes.description: Handles RPC communication with external clients, managing interface acquisition and release.

classes.name: AccessorOCDM
classes.description: Provides access to DRM systems, manages sessions, and handles various DRM-related operations.

classes.name: BufferAdministrator
classes.description: Manages buffer allocations for DRM sessions.

classes.name: SessionImplementation
classes.description: Represents a DRM session, handling session-specific operations and data exchange.

classes.name: DataExchange
classes.description: Handles data exchange for DRM sessions, running in a dedicated thread.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Callback handler for DRM session events such as key messages, errors, and status updates.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class for the plugin, including system definitions and blacklists.

classes.name: Systems
classes.description: Represents individual DRM system configurations within the plugin's JSON configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, loads DRM system factories, and sets up RPC interfaces.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deinitializes DRM systems.

methods.name: IsTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system and content type are supported.

methods.name: KeySystem
methods.description: Retrieves the IMediaKeys interface for a given key system.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetServerCertificate
methods.description: Sets the server certificate for a DRM system.

methods.name: GetVersionExt
methods.description: Retrieves the version extension string for a key system.

methods.name: GetLdlSessionLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit for LDL sessions for a key system.

methods.name: IsSecureStopEnabled
methods.description: Checks if secure stop is enabled for a key system.

methods.name: EnableSecureStop
methods.description: Enables or disables secure stop for a key system.

methods.name: ResetSecureStops
methods.description: Resets secure stops for a key system.

methods.name: GetSecureStopIds
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs for a key system.

methods.name: GetSecureStop
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop data for a session.

methods.name: CommitSecureStop
methods.description: Commits a secure stop response for a session.

methods.name: DeleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store for a key system.

methods.name: DeleteSecureStore
methods.description: Deletes the secure store for a key system.

methods.name: GetKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: GetSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the secure store.
